$comment: BF_PORTAL_v789_SCOPES - a PR's scope comes from its scope:<name> label (case-insensitive). No label means unscoped: nothing is denied. BF-only code is src/pages/** and src/components/**; BI and SLF PRs may touch only the shared CRM components listed in sharedCrmComponents. A scope's allow list re-permits paths its deny list covers.

unscoped.description: No scope label. May touch anything.

fullstack.description: Maintainer / cross-silo work. May touch anything.

BF.description: Boreal Financial work. Cannot modify BI or SLF silo code.

BI.description: Boreal Insurance work. Cannot modify SLF silo code or BF-only pages and components.

SLF.description: Site Level Financial work. Cannot modify BI silo code or BF-only pages and components.
